scenarios.name: Automatic secondmate recovery admission with real lab endpoint
scenarios.scope: Actual production owner and real private tmux shell endpoint with forbidden executable sentinels; no negative model session.

scenarios.name: Actual omp pending engine-selection refusal replay
scenarios.observed: Current-head production-generated pending record persisted at real ACP session close; replacement delivered one refusal user message; real message_start consumption removed it; later shutdown did not republish it; unchanged host refusal log proves no denied host retry. Removing lab supervision-host preserved enabled launch policy and did not invoke host.
scenarios.blocker: Actual watcher successor readiness failed after the owning extension retry bound; no ordinary watcher lock or beacon established.
scenarios.diagnosis: The current-head extension sets FM_ROOT_OVERRIDE and FM_CONFIG_OVERRIDE when spawning ordinary watch-arm. bin/fm-watch-arm.sh refuses disposable /.no-mistakes/worktrees/ invocations unless fm_gate_lab_permitted succeeds, whose owner rejects every nonempty FM_*_OVERRIDE. This phase permits only worktree-local source changes and does not authorize bypassing or changing protection.
scenarios.prerequisite: Authorize a supported lab source checkout outside the disposable gate path, or separately approve an owning isolation-contract correction. No protection was bypassed.

scenarios.observed: Real omp 18.6.3 used authorized openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol; same endpoint/worktree, new generation; inherited enabled child policy; actual worker spawn consumer refused Codex; preserved work, validation custody and charter.
